meta.anchor_note: All ratios in this matrix use the exact 24K gram price recorded in data/spot-and-standards.json so the 19 weight-bearing rows agree with Dataset C's stored melt values. data/prices.json carries a second, 0.012%-different anchor from GoldPrice.org; both are printed.
meta.formula: pure gold g = ring weight g × (karat ÷ 24); melt USD = pure gold g × (spot USD/oz ÷ 31.1034768)

requirements.title: Karat / purity stated
requirements.rule: The listing must print the karat (10K, 14K, 18K …). A karat in an image or in another seller's policy does not count for this column.
requirements.if_missing: Ask the seller in writing which karat the metal is and keep the reply with the order.

requirements.title: Word “solid” used
requirements.rule: The listing, or the seller's own materials policy, must say solid gold. Plated, vermeil, gold-filled, overlay and gold-tone do not qualify.
requirements.if_missing: Ask the seller to state “solid 14K gold” (or the karat bought) in writing before paying.

requirements.title: Hallmark (karat stamp) disclosed
requirements.rule: The seller should state that the piece is stamped with its karat. No seller in this file publishes a hallmark policy, so this column is almost always blank.
requirements.if_missing: Check the inside of the shank with a loupe the day the ring arrives.

requirements.title: Maker's mark disclosed
requirements.rule: Under 15 U.S.C. 297 a karat stamp must be accompanied by the manufacturer's or dealer's trademark or name. Two Dataset B listings document one.
requirements.if_missing: Ask the seller whose registered mark sits beside the karat stamp.

requirements.title: Finished weight in grams
requirements.rule: A legitimate seller can state the ring's weight in grams. Ranges, stone-inclusive totals and client-side-only figures are marked partial, never treated as a gold weight.
requirements.authority_label: NIST SP 811 App. B.9 (the gram used here)
requirements.if_missing: Ask for the weight in grams; if refused, that is the answer.

requirements.title: Independent seller reputation
requirements.rule: An independent review sample (Trustpilot or BBB) plus working contact details. A seller with no recorded sample is left blank, not assumed good.
requirements.if_missing: Search the business name plus “complaints” and call the published number.

requirements.title: Return window you can use
requirements.rule: No US statute sets a minimum return window for a correctly delivered ring, so the window is the seller's promise. It must be long enough to have the ring independently tested; resized, engraved, custom and final-sale exclusions are shown where the seller states them.
requirements.if_missing: Get the return window and exclusions in writing before ordering.

requirements.title: Credit card accepted
requirements.rule: A credit card gives Fair Credit Billing Act dispute rights. Bank wire, crypto and irreversible methods forfeit them; sellers that only advertise instalments are marked partial.
requirements.if_missing: Pay by credit card, or do not buy.

requirements.title: Documentation captured
requirements.rule: A verbatim price/description quote, the official URL it came from, and the date it was read. This is what you keep if the ring arrives wrong.
requirements.authority_label: 15 U.S.C. § 1666 (keep the evidence for a dispute)
requirements.if_missing: Screenshot the listing and save the receipt before the page changes.

requirements.title: Independent / XRF verification
requirements.rule: Whether the seller offers, or will accept, an assay. Practically every seller states nothing, so the fallback is your own jeweller inside the return window.
requirements.authority_label: 16 CFR Part 23 - a stamp is a marking, not an assay
requirements.if_missing: Book an XRF check with an independent jeweller before resizing or wearing.

rows_meeting_every_requirement.note: Every one of the ten requirements must be ‘good’ — an official page states it.

rows_with_core_five.definition: karat + solid wording + weight + hallmark + maker's mark + returns + card payment + XRF, each at least partly documented

rows_seller_core_all_good.definition: karat + word “solid” + weight in grams + a usable return window, all ‘good’

rows_seller_core_partial.definition: the same four, at least partly documented
